recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-7091 unless a human separately wants to investigate the historical mismatch between the Jira-tagged #7091 commit and the Composition wording removed by #7404.
issue_request: FHIR-7091 was Published/Persuasive for a DSTU1 technical correction on Composition section 6.9.5: remove the extra "a" from "the a resource may have mandatory elements" in narrative-only Composition guidance.
initial_application: The explicit git commit tagged for the issue is 2124ac280e7ddf0f6530036e301c4f3ca4e14253 ("#7091 - typo"), but it corrected a similar "the a resource" typo in the then-current ImplementationGuide spreadsheet rather than the Composition note. The exact Composition sentence from the Jira existed in source/composition/composition-notes.xml before 749c4dd88234688f57191d3d0b4d62bdc525b87d, and that earlier #7404 documentation commit removed the whole obsolete note before the tagged FHIR-7091 commit.
additional_context: Composition is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini, and current source/composition/composition-notes.xml now states directly that a Composition may contain only Composition.section.text and no Composition.section.entry. Repository searches found no remaining "the a resource" typo or old mandatory-elements sentence in current source. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant discussion changing this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scoped Composition source no longer contains the requested typo, and the current wording already conveys the narrative-only Composition rule without the removed parenthetical.

related_jiras.note: The #7404 documentation commit removed the obsolete Composition note containing the FHIR-7091 typo before the explicit #7091 typo commit; FHIR-7404 itself was not decided because its narrative/documentation scope is broader than this typo audit.
